data.notes: January 2026 mixed arena-scale pop and rock with a strong Hollywood/Downtown electronic-club calendar and a notable Blue Note LA run.

events.title: Foo Fighters: A Show Benefitting Hope United
events.summary: Foo Fighters played a one-night Kia Forum benefit show tied to Hope United / Hope The Mission and Los Angeles Mission. The date was confirmed by Ticketmaster and Kia Forum ticketing materials.

events.title: Wyclef Jean at Blue Note Los Angeles
events.summary: Wyclef Jean held a multi-night Blue Note Los Angeles run from January 15–18. Blue Note billed him as a Grammy Award-winning artist, producer, composer, and founding member of the Fugees.

events.title: Chus & Ceballos — Reunion Tour
events.summary: Insomniac presented Chus & Ceballos’ Reunion Tour at Academy LA. The official event page listed a 10:00 PM–3:00 AM 21+ club show.

events.title: TWICE [THIS IS FOR] World Tour in Los Angeles
events.summary: TWICE brought the [THIS IS FOR] World Tour to Kia Forum for a four-night Los Angeles run on January 21, 22, 24, and 25. Ticketmaster listed the Inglewood dates as part of the group’s 2026 tour.

events.title: PERSONA LIVE 2026: AWAKENINGS
events.summary: PERSONA LIVE 2026: AWAKENINGS was confirmed at Dolby Theatre in Hollywood on January 24. The concert featured music from the Persona game series in a dedicated live production.

events.title: Cosmic Gate — Perspectives II Tour Open-to-Close Set
events.summary: Cosmic Gate played an open-to-close set at Exchange LA for Insomniac/Dreamstate’s trance audience. Resident Advisor listed the show for January 24 with a 10:00 PM–3:00 AM runtime.

events.title: Hilary Duff — Small Rooms, Big Nerves
events.summary: Hilary Duff’s Small Rooms, Big Nerves mini-tour stopped at The Wiltern on January 29. Ticketmaster listed the Los Angeles show as part of the four-date run.

events.title: Cannons
events.summary: Goldenvoice presented Cannons at the Fonda Theatre on January 29, with French Perfume and Liz Sanchez also listed on the bill. AXS confirmed the 9:00 PM show time and all-ages admission.

events.title: Space Yacht Anniversary: Big Bass Ting & Critical Mass DNB
events.summary: Space Yacht marked its anniversary at Academy LA with Big Bass Ting and Critical Mass DNB across two rooms. Resident Advisor listed the event for January 3 with a secret lineup.

events.title: Space Yacht: Tech My House
events.summary: Insomniac listed Space Yacht: Tech My House at Academy LA on January 10. The official page confirmed a secret house lineup and a 10:00 PM–3:00 AM 21+ format.

events.title: Mita Gami — Stranger Than at The Theatre
events.summary: Stranger Than presented Mita Gami for the 2026 reopening of The Theatre in Downtown Los Angeles. Resident Advisor listed the January 31 event with a 9:00 PM–2:00 AM schedule.

events.title: Boombox Cartel at Exchange LA
events.summary: Exchange LA’s venue calendar listed Boombox Cartel for Saturday, January 31 at 10:00 PM. The booking capped a month of Insomniac-backed electronic programming at the Downtown club.
